# @vanya/ui — Vanya-Arc/UI

> Public React design system with a single Russian longread, reusable components, real examples and browser-native navigation. Only public information is documented.

## Overview
- [Single longread](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/): Human reference, semantic HTML and interactive demos.
- [Longread Markdown](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/index.md): Text without JavaScript.
- [Navigation rule](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/navigation.md): URLs, browser history and links.

## Reference
- [Components](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/components.md): Real exported React components and source links.
- [Tokens](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/tokens.md): Generated theme tokens.
- [Composition](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/composition.md): Reusable interface patterns.
- [Workspace scrolling](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/workspaces.md): Scroll owners and sticky context.
- [Installation](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/installation.md): How to use @vanya/ui.
- [Publication safety](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/reference/publication-safety.md): Public-source boundary.

## Source
- [Public GitHub repository](https://github.com/VanDalkvist/vanya-ui): Source, tests, MIT license.
- [Extended machine-readable reference](https://ui.vanya-arc.dev/llms-full.txt): Generated tokens and export index.

This is a navigation aid for agents, not an indexing or ranking guarantee.
